scenario.description: A process engineering manager must authorize tomorrow's heat-treatment run for 480 aerospace brackets and finalize the furnace loading, inspection, and maintenance controls, with input from quality and maintenance.

shared_context.S1: Oven 2 is scheduled for an eight-hour heat-treatment window tomorrow from 07:00 to 15:00.
shared_context.S2: The production batch contains 480 aerospace brackets, and Oven 2 normally processes this type of batch in one 480-unit load.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the final decision on whether and how the batch is processed.
shared_context.S4: At the daily thermal-processing review, Elena routinely asks quality and maintenance to report any customer, equipment, or control information before authorizing a run. Once required controls are accounted for and the maintenance work is scheduled, the review procedure calls for Elena to authorize the compliant run.
shared_context.S5: The validated production schedule reserves the full 07:00 to 15:00 window for this batch but does not specify the loading arrangement.
shared_context.S6: The reserved window is sufficient for the compliant plan, including the required two-load arrangement and the two-hour filter replacement; Elena does not need any additional cycle-time confirmation before authorizing once the reported controls and equipment constraint have been accounted for.

PF1.text: Ravi confirmed in the customer's control portal this morning that every furnace load requires exactly 5 witness coupons and hardness testing of those coupons before release; the local traveler has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: Marta's airflow inspection found a temporarily restricted filter in Oven 2, limiting a safe qualified load to exactly 240 brackets until the filter is replaced; she confirmed the replacement will take exactly 2 hours, but the maintenance log has not yet been updated.

acceptance_conditions: The batch must be processed as two loads of exactly 240 brackets each.
Each furnace load must use exactly 5 witness coupons.
The witness coupons must receive hardness testing before release.
The filter replacement must be planned for exactly 2 hours.
The settlement must record two 240-unit loads and a 2-hour filter replacement.
The customer control-plan finding must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The customer portal requirement changes the inspection plan to exactly 5 witness coupons per load and mandatory hardness testing before release, and it supplies the fact that must be cited.
The restricted filter changes the loading plan from one 480-unit load to two 240-unit loads and changes the maintenance plan to an exact 2-hour filter replacement.
